items.titleZh: 劳森因更换动力单元和调整设置，今日将从维修区起步 #F1 #墨西哥站
items.summaryZh: 劳森因更换动力单元和调整设置，今日将从维修区起步。尽管车队自行披露违规，但 stewards 确认劳森被取消排位赛成绩。
items.originalTitle: Lawson will now start from the pit lane today after taking a new PU and making set-up changes #F1 #MexicoGP
items.summaryEn:
Lawson will now start from the pit lane today after taking a new PU and making set-up changes #F1 #MexicoGPChris Medland: Confirmed: Lawson is disqualified from the qualifying results, despite his team self-disclosing the breach
The stewards note there are a number of precedents that means a technical infringement has to be disqualification #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
劳森因更换动力单元和调整设置，今日将从维修区起步 #F1 #墨西哥站Chris Medland: 确认：劳森被取消排位赛成绩，尽管他的车队自行披露违规
 stewards 指出，有多个先例表明技术违规必须取消成绩 #F1 #墨西哥站
detailEn:
Lawson will now start from the pit lane today after taking a new PU and making set-up changes #F1 #MexicoGPChris Medland: Confirmed: Lawson is disqualified from the qualifying results, despite his team self-disclosing the breach
The stewards note there are a number of precedents that means a technical infringement has to be disqualification #F1 #MexicoGP
